score_conclusion.verbatim: Removing the unused class solves passed all 30 cases and reduced the reported raw time to **0.524686 seconds**. Local checks across all public inputs also passed for hard-minimum updates below epsilon 8 and two sparse variants. The later 8-neighbor variant had the best accuracy margin, with worst normalized RMSE **0.00226**. I’m comparing their runtimes before the next full evaluation.

next_decision.verbatim: The high-temperature Gibbs-kernel variant was fastest in the local comparison and is now in full evaluation. It uses matrix-vector products when the numerical range permits, falls back to log-domain updates when needed, and retains the tested low-temperature approximation. I’m checking whether the same approach helps the batched class solves.
